keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Denville Township, homeowners pay an average of $14,404.25 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.19% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 83.2%, assessed values average ~83.2% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 65.4% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 24.8%, and Morris County claims 9.8%.
